description: One record per search result or fetched page with clean Markdown/text/HTML, links, page metadata for citations, optional heading-aware chunks, and the search-engine provenance of each result. Pages that could not be fetched still produce a metadata-only record with a `fetchError` note when `emitFailedResults` is on.
